national_news.title: Fourth Round of India-Singapore Ministerial Roundtable Held in Singapore
bullets: The 4th round of the India-Singapore Ministerial Roundtable (ISMR) was held in Singapore to review progress and drive bilateral cooperation.
The Indian ministerial delegation included Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman, External Affairs Minister Dr. S. Jaishankar, Commerce and Industry Minister Piyush Goyal, and MoS Jitin Prasada.
Discussions focused on Advanced Manufacturing, Connectivity, Digitalization, Healthcare, Skills Development, and Sustainability under the Comprehensive Strategic Partnership (CSP) Roadmap.

national_news.title: US President Announces Sweeping Economic Warfare Campaign Against Iran
bullets: US President Donald Trump announced a campaign of economic warfare and isolation against Iran, targeting key financial lifelines and oil-smuggling networks.
The US administration warned of economic consequences for any nation or financial institution providing support to Tehran.
Tensions remain high around the Strait of Hormuz, with Iran demanding the lifting of the US blockade and frozen assets before reopening the vital shipping route.

national_news.title: 2nd BRICS 2026 Tourism Working Group Meeting Held in Jaipur
bullets: The Ministry of Tourism hosted the 2nd BRICS 2026 Tourism Working Group Meeting in Jaipur under India's BRICS Chairship.
The meeting was chaired by Bhuvnesh Kumar, Secretary, Ministry of Tourism, focusing on Artificial Intelligence in tourism, sustainability, skilling, and seamless travel.
Discussions centered on the overarching theme 'Building for Resilience, Innovation, Cooperation and Sustainability'.

national_news.title: Government Priority is Cost-Effective and High-Quality Infrastructure: Nitin Gadkari
bullets: Road Transport and Highways Minister Nitin Gadkari stated that the government's foremost priority is delivering high-quality, cost-effective infrastructure without compromise.
The Ministry plans to review highway subcontracting provisions to ensure principal contractors retain direct responsibility for timely execution and quality.
The Ministry is preparing tunnel tenders worth ₹2 to ₹2.5 lakh crore, focusing on advanced technologies like precast methodology and Tunnel Boring Machines for Himalayan terrains.

national_news.title: Youth Drive Formal Employment Growth in India with 79% New UANs in 18-30 Age Group
bullets: According to the 'Pulse FY2026' report, 79 per cent of new Universal Account Numbers (UANs) generated during 2025-26 belonged to individuals aged 18 to 30 years.
The 21-25 age group accounted for over 35 per cent of new accounts, forming the largest segment entering formal employment.
The automotive sector accounted for over 51 per cent of the 64,000 apprenticeship contracts facilitated under the National Apprenticeship Promotion Scheme, with women securing 26 per cent of them.

national_news.title: Civil Aviation Minister Flags Off Expanded Transshipment Cargo Operations at Delhi Airport
bullets: Union Minister for Civil Aviation Ram Mohan Naidu flagged off the scaled-up phase of India's transshipment cargo reform at Delhi International Airport Limited's Transshipment Excellence Centre.
The reform eliminates mandatory re-screening for domestic-to-international transshipment cargo, reducing average end-to-end transit time from 60 hours to 20 hours.
The network was expanded to four domestic stations (Bengaluru, Ahmedabad, Mumbai, Hyderabad) and two international destinations (London, Copenhagen).

national_news.title: Cabinet Approves Four Multi-Tracking Railway Projects Across Four States
bullets: The Cabinet Committee on Economic Affairs (CCEA), chaired by Prime Minister Narendra Modi, approved four multi-tracking railway projects worth approximately Rs. 9,450 crore.
The projects cover eight districts across West Bengal, Odisha, Tamil Nadu, and Andhra Pradesh, increasing the Indian Railways network by about 410 km.
Planned under the PM-Gati Shakti National Master Plan, the projects will generate an additional freight traffic of 76 Million Tonnes Per Annum (MTPA) and are targeted for completion by 2030-31.

national_news.title: India and Malaysia Strengthen Cooperation on Public Administration and Governance
bullets: India and Malaysia held their 2nd Joint Working Group Meeting, reaffirming commitment to public administration, governance reforms, and capacity building.
Discussions highlighted India's CPGRAMS platform and the AI-enabled voice chatbot 'Samadhan Didi' launched by DARPG on May 30, 2026.
The Malaysian side presented the Action Plan for the Malaysia-India Governance Partnership for 2027-2029.

national_news.title: Technology Development Board Backs Orthograft for Tissue-Derived Biological Dressings
bullets: The Technology Development Board (TDB) under the Department of Science and Technology provided financial assistance to Gujarat-based startup Orthograft.
The funding supports the project 'Production Setup of Advanced Tissue Derived Biological Dressings' for chronic wounds, diabetic foot ulcers, and burns.
Orthograft operates out of the Savli Technology Business Incubator in Vadodara and holds two approved US patents for tissue processing.

national_news.title: India's Medical Tourism Industry Projected to Reach $16.2 Billion by 2030
bullets: India's medical tourism market is valued at $8.7 billion in 2025 and is projected to nearly double to $16.2 billion by 2030.
In 2025, India recorded 5,07,244 foreign nationals arriving specifically for medical treatments, led by patients from Bangladesh, Iraq, Uzbekistan, and Somalia.
India ranks 10th globally among medical tourism destinations and 5th in wellness tourism in the Asia-Pacific region according to the Medical Tourism Index.

national_news.title: PIB Dehradun Organises Regional Media Workshop 'Vartalaap' in Chamoli
bullets: The Press Information Bureau (PIB), Dehradun, under the Ministry of Information and Broadcasting, organized the regional media workshop 'Vartalaap' in Gopeshwar, Chamoli on August 20.

The workshop aims to strengthen communication between the government and local media in rural and border areas, ensuring the dissemination of accurate information on Central Government welfare schemes.

Special sessions focused on women and youth empowerment, farmer welfare, healthcare, Geographical Indication (GI) tags, One District One Product (ODOP), and flagship initiatives like Ayushman Bharat and Pradhan Mantri Matru Vandana Yojana.

national_news.title: Government Prioritizes High-Quality and Cost-Effective Infrastructure: Nitin Gadkari
bullets: Road Transport and Highways Minister Nitin Gadkari emphasized cost-effective and high-quality infrastructure development at the fourth edition of the Tunnels and Bridges Conference 2026 in New Delhi.
The Ministry plans to review subcontracting provisions to ensure principal contractors retain direct responsibility for timely execution and quality.
The Ministry is preparing tunnel tenders worth Rs 2 to 2.5 lakh crore, focusing on advanced technologies like precast methodology and Tunnel Boring Machines in Himalayan terrains.

national_news.title: Youth Drive Formal Employment Growth in India with 79% New UANs from 18-30 Age Group
bullets: According to the 'Pulse FY2026' report, 79% of new Universal Account Numbers (UANs) generated during 2025-26 belonged to individuals aged 18 to 30 years.
The 21 to 25 age group accounted for over 35% of new accounts, emerging as the largest demographic entering formal employment.
Nearly 69% of the organized workforce was deployed across tier-II and tier-III cities, while automotive sector led the National Apprenticeship Promotion Scheme contracts.

bullets: The Ministry of Tourism hosted the 2nd BRICS 2026 Tourism Working Group Meeting in Jaipur, Rajasthan, under India's BRICS Chairship.

Discussions centered on the overarching theme 'Building for Resilience, Innovation, Cooperation and Sustainability'.

The initiative will generate an additional freight traffic capacity of 76 MTPA and reduce CO2 emissions by approximately 65 crore kg.

national_news.title: India and Malaysia Pledge Deeper Cooperation on Public Administration and Governance
bullets: India and Malaysia held their 2nd Joint Working Group (JWG) meeting, reaffirming commitment to public administration, governance reforms, and capacity building.
The Indian side highlighted digital governance tools, including CPGRAMS and the AI-enabled voice chatbot 'Samadhan Didi' launched by DARPG on May 30, 2026.
The Malaysian side presented the action plan for the Malaysia-India Governance Partnership (2027-2029) to foster digital government and institutional engagement.

national_news.title: TDB Financials Gujarat Startup Orthograft for Advanced Tissue Biological Dressings
bullets: The Technology Development Board (TDB) under the Department of Science and Technology (DST) provided financial assistance to Gujarat-based startup Orthograft.
The funding supports the project 'Production Setup of Advanced Tissue Derived Biological Dressings' for indigenous clinical treatment of chronic wounds and burns.
The startup will set up production infrastructure at the Savli Technology Business Incubator in Vadodara, holding two approved US patents.

national_news.title: India's Medical Tourism Sector Valued at $8.7 Billion in 2025, Projected to Reach $16.2 Billion by 2030
bullets: India's medical tourism market reached an estimated $8.7 billion in 2025, with projections to nearly double to $16.2 billion by 2030.
India recorded 5,07,244 foreign nationals arriving specifically for medical treatment in 2025, driven largely by patients from Bangladesh, Iraq, Uzbekistan, and Somalia.
The sector encompasses curative interventions alongside preventive wellness tourism powered by Yoga, Ayurveda, and other AYUSH practices.

bullets: Union Minister Nitin Gadkari stated that the government's foremost priority is providing high-quality and cost-effective infrastructure without compromising standards.

The Ministry plans to review subcontracting provisions and link tender eligibility to performance assessments of contractors and consultants preparing Detailed Project Reports (DPRs).

national_news.title: RDI Fund Equipped with Stringent Safeguards to Protect Taxpayers and Private Capital: Dr Jitendra Singh
bullets: Science and Technology Minister Dr Jitendra Singh chaired the monthly joint meeting of Science Secretaries in New Delhi.
The Research, Development, and Innovation (RDI) Fund includes a Conflict of Interest policy with stringent safeguards to protect both taxpayers' money and private capital.
Private equity sources are expected to contribute 50 percent of the investment under the RDI Fund model.

bullets: According to the 'Pulse FY2026' report, 79 percent of new Universal Account Numbers (UANs) generated during 2025-26 belonged to individuals aged 18 to 30 years.
The 21-25 age group accounted for over 35 percent of new UANs, emerging as the largest segment entering formal employment.
Women accounted for nearly 28 percent of new UANs generated, and tier-II and tier-III cities accounted for nearly 69 percent of the deployed workforce.

national_news.title: Delhi Flags Off 200 New Electric Buses, Expanding Fleet Past 5,000
bullets: Delhi Lieutenant Governor Taranjit Singh Sandhu and Chief Minister Rekha Gupta flagged off 200 zero-emission electric buses from the Delhi University Sports Complex.
The expansion takes Delhi's total electric bus fleet beyond 5,000, while the overall bus fleet has reached approximately 6,800.
The government plans to convert the entire DTC fleet to electric and expand the total fleet to around 14,000 by 2028-29.
New initiatives include the Delhi-Karnal interstate e-bus service and 56 dedicated Ladies Special e-bus services integrated with panic buttons and Delhi Police 112.

bullets: The Cabinet Committee on Economic Affairs (CCEA) approved four multi-tracking railway projects spanning West Bengal, Odisha, Tamil Nadu, and Andhra Pradesh, covering an increased network of about 410 km.

bullets: India's medical value travel (MVT) market stood at $8.7 billion in 2025, drawing over 5 lakh foreign patients, and is projected to scale up to $16.2 billion by 2030.
Bangladesh, Iraq, Uzbekistan, Somalia, and Oman emerged as the top source countries for medical tourists visiting India for treatments and AYUSH wellness therapies.
According to the Medical Tourism Index, India ranks 10th globally among medical tourism destinations and 5th in the Asia-Pacific wellness tourism market.

national_news.title: Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman Addresses PSB Confluence 2026
bullets: The two-day PSB Confluence 2026 was organized by the Department of Financial Services (DFS), Ministry of Finance.
Announced a focused month-long campaign starting October 2, 2026, for youth above 16 years to engage them with the formal financial system via the Indian Banks' Association (IBA).
Emphasized maintaining focus on Priority Sector Lending (PSL) and enhancing financing across agriculture and horticulture value chains.

national_news.title: India’s Trade Agreements in Action and Export Performance
bullets: Combined merchandise and services exports reached a record US$ 863.1 billion in FY 2025-26, with merchandise exports at US$ 441.8 billion.
During April-June 2026, combined exports touched US$ 232.73 billion, registering an 11.37% growth.
The India-UAE CEPA (effective May 1, 2022) remains India's largest individual FTA export market, with bilateral trade crossing US$ 100 billion in FY 2024-25.

national_news.title: Ministry of Youth Affairs & Sports Announces National Sports Awards 2025
bullets: The National Sports Awards 2025 selection committee was chaired by former Supreme Court Judge Justice (Retd.) Arun Kumar Mishra.
Prominent sportspersons awarded the Arjuna Award include Tejaswin Shankar (Athletics), Treesa Jolly (Badminton), Vidit Santosh Gujarathi and Divya Jitendra Deshmukh (Chess).
Army Paralympic Node, Pune, was selected for the Rashtriya Khel Protsahan Puruskar 2025 for sports promotion.

bullets: Road Transport and Highways Minister Nitin Gadkari addressed the fourth edition of the Tunnels and Bridges Conference 2026 in New Delhi.

The Ministry plans to review subcontracting provisions and link consultant tender eligibility to performance assessments of Detailed Project Reports (DPRs).

bullets: Science and Technology Minister Dr Jitendra Singh chaired the monthly joint meeting of Science Secretaries in New Delhi.
The Research, Development, and Innovation (RDI) Fund involves a shared responsibility with 50 per cent of investment expected from private equity sources.
Inter-ministerial consultations are underway to make the RDI Fund framework more inclusive for strategic technology requirements.

national_news.title: Delhi Flags Off 200 Zero-Emission Electric Buses to Expand Green Fleet
bullets: Delhi Lieutenant Governor Taranjit Singh Sandhu and Chief Minister Rekha Gupta flagged off 200 new zero-emission electric buses from the Delhi University Sports Complex.
The addition pushes Delhi's electric bus fleet beyond 5,000, with a total bus fleet of around 6,800, under plans to reach 14,000 buses by 2028-29.
A new Delhi-Karnal interstate e-bus service and 56 dedicated Ladies Special e-bus services integrated with the Delhi Police 112 emergency system were also launched.

bihar_news.title: Union Cabinet Approves Major Rail and Highway Projects Worth Rs 13,041 Crore
bullets: The Cabinet Committee on Economic Affairs approved infrastructure projects worth approximately Rs 13,041 crore across five states, including West Bengal, Odisha, Tamil Nadu, Andhra Pradesh, and Bihar.
Four railway multi-tracking projects on the Howrah-Chennai high-density network worth Rs 9,450 crore will add 410 km to the network by 2030-31.
In Bihar, the Rs 3,590.73-crore four-laning of the Muzaffarpur-Sitamarhi-Sonbarsa section of NH-22 was approved under the Hybrid Annuity Mode (HAM).

bihar_news.title: Bihar CM Highlights Key Infrastructure, Irrigation and Defence Initiatives
bullets: Bihar Chief Minister Samrat Choudhary welcomed the Union Cabinet's approval for upgrading the Muzaffarpur-Sitamarhi-Sonbarsa section of NH-22 to four-lane standards at a cost of Rs 3,590.73 crore.
The state government gave an in-principle approval to develop a 336-km, six-lane fully access-controlled greenfield expressway connecting Buxar and Bhagalpur via a PPP model.
The CM also lauded the Centre's decision to indigenise 405 strategic defence equipment items to bolster domestic manufacturing and MSMEs under Aatmanirbhar Bharat.

bihar_news.title: Bihar CM Reviews Rs 6,282 Crore Kosi-Mechi Inter-State River Link Project
bullets: Bihar CM Samrat Choudhary inspected the under-construction Kosi-Mechi Inter-State River Link Project in Supaul district, targeting completion by March 2029.
The Rs 6,282.32-crore project aims to provide assured irrigation to 2,14,813 hectares of agricultural land across four Seemanchal districts: Araria, Purnea, Kishanganj, and Katihar.
Excess water from the Kosi River will be diverted through a link canal to the Mechi River to enhance water availability in the Mahananda basin and mitigate floods.

bihar_news.title: Cabinet Approves Upgradation of Muzaffarpur-Sitamarhi-Sonbarsa Section of NH-22 in Bihar
bullets: The CCEA approved the four-laning of the Muzaffarpur-Sitamarhi-Sonbarsa section of NH-22 in Bihar at a capital cost of Rs 3,590.73 crore.
The 82.578 km project will be developed on the Hybrid Annuity Mode (HAM).
It acts as a key feeder corridor connecting the India-Nepal border at Sonbarsa with economic centers like Muzaffarpur on NH-27 (East-West Corridor).

bihar_news.title: Bihar Cabinet Clears Two Sugar Mill Projects Worth Rs 422.5 Crore in East Champaran
bullets: The Bihar cabinet approved two sugar mill projects with a total investment of Rs 422.5 crore in East Champaran district.
Shree Ganesh Sugar Mills Private Limited received approval for a Rs 180 crore project in Chorma, Pakridayal block, featuring a 5,000 TCD sugar mill and distillery.
Rajshree Sugars secured approval for a Rs 242.5 crore project in Kotwa block, including a 5,000 TCD sugar mill, a 28 MW co-generation plant, and a 60 KLPD distillery.

bihar_news.title: Bihar Agri-PV Summit 2026 Explores Integration of Farming and Solar Energy
bullets: The Bihar Agri-PV Summit 2026 was held in Patna to promote the integration of agriculture and solar energy.
Experts highlighted that agri-photovoltaic (PV) models can optimize limited fertile land in Bihar, increasing farmers' incomes.
Closer coordination between the agriculture and energy sectors aims to support the state's clean and renewable energy targets.

bihar_news.title: Sherghati-Kajree New Broad Gauge Line Project Sanctioned for Bihar and Jharkhand
bullets: The Sherghati-Kajree New Broad Gauge (BG) railway line project has been officially sanctioned spanning Bihar and Jharkhand.
The infrastructure project involves the development of a 107.89 km long new broad gauge railway line.
The initiative aims to improve regional rail connectivity and economic integration between the two states.

bihar_news.title: Legal Status of Indian Passport and Electoral Rolls Verification
bullets: The Ministry of External Affairs clarified that an Indian passport issued under the Passports Act, 1967 is primarily a travel document rather than conclusive proof of citizenship.

The Supreme Court, in Association for Democratic Reforms v. Election Commission of India (May 2026), upheld the EC's authority to conduct Special Intensive Revision (SIR) of electoral rolls in Bihar under Article 324 and Section 21(3) of the Representation of the People Act, 1950.

The Supreme Court ruled that the EC's power to assess citizenship during electoral verification is prima facie in character, while final citizenship determination remains under the Citizenship Act, 1955.

bihar_news.title: India's Electoral System and Voter Identification Framework
bullets: US President Donald Trump praised India's voter identification system and robust electoral framework following discussions with Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar.
India's massive electoral machinery managed over 642 million voters during the 2024 Lok Sabha elections across more than a million polling stations.

The multi-layered electoral security relies on constitutional oversight by the Election Commission, Electoral Photo Identity Cards (EPIC), Booth Level Officers, Electronic Voting Machines (EVMs), and VVPAT verification systems.

bihar_news.title: Bihar's Critical Mineral Potential Highlights New Investment Opportunities
bullets: Bihar Deputy Chief Minister Samrat Choudhary highlighted the state's critical mineral potential to attract investments.
The focus is on boosting innovation and industrial growth by harnessing local mineral resources in Bihar.
The initiative aims to open new economic avenues in the mining and manufacturing sectors.

The project is being executed under the East Central Railway (ECR) zone.

bihar_news.title: Legal Status of Passports and Electoral Verification in India
bullets: The Ministry of External Affairs clarified that an Indian passport is primarily a travel document issued under the Passports Act, 1967, rather than conclusive proof of citizenship.

The Supreme Court, in Association for Democratic Reforms v. Election Commission of India (May 2026), upheld the EC's authority to conduct the Bihar Special Intensive Revision (SIR) under Article 324 and the Representation of the People Act, 1950.
